review_evidence: The retained Cowles, hints, proof-builder, Quicklisp, tau/textbook, and tools books contain package definitions, executable interfaces, macros, examples, and named DEFTHM/DEFUN events; e.g. the tools and hints sources implement reusable prover support rather than build-only metadata.

All selected .acl2/customization sidecars were inspected as complete files. They contain only IN-PACKAGE, LD/INCLUDE-BOOK, CERTIFY-BOOK, RUN-SCRIPT, certification flags, or runtime settings. books/textbook/chap10/compiler.acl2 is deliberately retained because it owns the COMPILE DEFPKG event.
Nonempty .sys/*@useless-runes.lsp proof metadata remains searchable under FD-017, and descriptive formal-source Readme.lsp files remain retained.

rules.content_invariant: Every selected file only loads/certifies already-retained source or adjusts certification/runtime state; none owns a mathematical definition, theorem, package declaration, reusable interface, or standalone formal example.
evidence: Full-file inspection covered every selected .acl2/customization file, including comment-only cert-flag files such as oracle-time*.acl2 and tools/top.acl2.
The one retained .acl2 exception, textbook/chap10/compiler.acl2, contains a DEFPKG declaration and is therefore not selected.

summary: Reviewed the Cowles/hints/proof-builder/Quicklisp/tau/textbook/tools unit. Substantive theorem, implementation, package, example, and proof-metadata sources remain searchable; declaration-free certification and setup drivers are excluded.
